title.narrative: IDPs and Famine Response Targeting Conflict-affected People with Water, Sanitation and Hygiene and ES/NFIs in Tawila and El fasher, North Darfur

description.narrative: ltpgtltbrgtIn response to the risk of famine in North Darfur with some areas facing extreme food insecurity indicative of Emergency (IPC Phase 4) and Catastrophe (IPC Phase 5) aggravated by the ongoing conflict and flooding in North Darfur, GOAL, Solidarites International, DCD and Aljuzur propose to work in a consortium to undertake an integrated WASH and Emergency Shelter and NFIs targeting IDPs and host communities in El Fasher and Tawila. The conflict, coupled with the flash floods that have occurred in various parts of the North Darfur, the situation in El Fasher and Tawila(where most IDPs from El Fasher have fled to), is dire and requires urgent intervention. SI is planning on rehabilitating 18 water facilities (10 handpumps, 8 water yards) in Tawila, prioritizing IDP sites to accommodate the high number of new arrivals fleeing the conflict in El Fasher. SI will support 5,333 people through emergency water trucking while the WASH assets are being rehabilitated. SI will establish or support a WUC for each water point rehabilitated. Each WUC member (among whom 50% of women) will be trained and equipped with basic maintenance tools and spare part to ensure sustainability of water services. ltbrgtSI and DCD plan to carry out emergency latrine construction of 40 units, rehabilitate 10 latrines blocks and desludged 20 in Tawila IDP gathering sites. All newly constructed or rehabilitated latrines will be gender segregated and equipped with cleaning material. In addition, cleaning campaigns and hygiene promotion will be conducted to enhance best hygiene practices with an expected benefit to 33,000 individuals. Lastly, 1,660 IDP households will receive WASH kits, prioritizing women and girls in reproductive age as the kits will include MHM items.ltbrgtThe interventions planned by the consortium will benefit 79,660 individuals, including 17,565 men, 18,282 women, 21,468 boys and 22,345 girls from ElFasher and Tawila.ltbrgtThe program will provide timely life-saving assistance to crisis affected people to reduce mortality and morbidity by providing life-sustaining basic services which includes Water, Sanitation and Hygiene, Emergency shelter and distribution of Non-food Items. ltbrgtWhile GOAL plans to implement Water, Sanitation and Hygiene (WASH), coupled with NFI distribution in El Fasher, Solidarite International (SI) GOAL plans to provide comprehensive WASH services in Tawila. GOAL plans to provide water trucking in health facilities based on the needs in each facility targeting facilities serving Zam Zam, Shala and Saloma IDPs . Other health facilities, including mobile health clinics will be prioritised depending on identified needs gaps and coordination with other humanitarian actors. GOAL expects reach an estimated 46,660 individuals with 7.5 litres per day per person, according to SPHERE standards, across the targeted health facilities. However, the number of individuals reached will vary depending on the number of served health facilities. GOAL will ensure the quality of the water through regular water quality monitoring and chlorination. GOAL and Aljuzur will prioritise operation and maintenance of safe water sources in the project locations. GOAL will work with Aljuzur to provide fuel for the generators and rehabilitate water facilities. ltbrgtHandpumps will be repaired and solar systems installed or rehabilitated where necessary. In addition, GOAL and SI will undertake to rehabilitate and construct emergency latrines in IDP gathering sites in Tawila and El Fasher. GOAL will construct 320 emergency latrines and rehabilitate 80 latrines. Sanitation Committees will receive latrine cleaning materials and training to clean and maintain the latrines. Moreover, GOAL will purchase and distribute tarpaulins and NFIs to the most vulnerable households at IDP gathering sites, reaching 2500 Households (15,000 individuals).ltbrgtlt/pgt
